DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードが見当たらないというご相談ですね。いま確認できていることからお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a card you cannot find. Please start with what you have confirmed so far.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもの財布に銀行のカードがありません。ほかのかばんに移したかもしれませんが、なくした可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布になく別かばんへ移した可能性と紛失の可能性を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My bank card is not in my usual wallet. I may have moved it to another bag, but I may also have lost it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it is missing from your wallet and may be in another bag or lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つかるかもしれない場合も、まず担当へ状況を伝えましょう。最後に使った場所と時期はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even if it may turn up, let us first tell the person responsible what has happened. Do you know where and when you last used it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日、買物の前に使いました。使った後は財布へ戻したつもりですが、その場をはっきり覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日買物前に使い財布へ戻したつもりだが明確に覚えていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used it yesterday before shopping. I thought I put it back in my wallet afterward, but I do not clearly remember doing so.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you used it before shopping yesterday and thought you put it back in your wallet, but do not remember clearly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 戻したことは未確認として伺います。この練習では利用停止などの対応を担当者に確認しますので、先におつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record that putting it back is unconfirmed. In this exercise, we will ask the person responsible about measures such as suspending the card, so I will connect you first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別のかばんを探し終えるまで待たずに相談します。停止の相談が済んだ後に見つかったら、どう伝えればよいかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別かばんの確認を待たず相談し停止後に発見した場合も聞きたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will seek advice without waiting to finish searching my other bag. I also want to know what to report if I find it after discussing suspension.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will seek advice without waiting to check the other bag, and also ask about finding it after suspension. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見つかった場合の扱いも、担当者へ確認してください。見つかっただけでそのまま使えるとは、ここで判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the person responsible what to do if it is found as well. We will not decide here that finding it means you can simply use it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし見つかっても自己判断で使わず、担当へ連絡します。最後に使った店の近くの場所もメモに残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見つかっても使う前に担当へ連絡し最終使用場所をメモすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if I find it, I will contact the person responsible before using it on my own judgment. I will also note the location near the shop where I last used it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the person responsible before using a found card and note where you last used it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当には、そのメモと現在連絡できる方法を伝えられます。こちらから確認前に停止完了とお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can give them that note and a way to contact you now. We cannot promise that suspension is complete before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停止できたかを担当に確認し、見つかった場合の連絡方法も聞きます。戻したという記憶が曖昧なことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止の確認と発見時の連絡方法を担当へ聞き戻した記憶は曖昧と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm with them whether it was suspended and ask how to contact them if I find it. I will also explain that my memory of putting it back is uncertain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about suspension confirmation and contact details if found, and explain your uncertain memory of putting it back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、カードの対応を扱う担当へすぐご案内します。続きは担当の確認を受けながらお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will now take you straight to the person handling card matters. Please continue the discussion while they confirm the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご購入品のご相談ですね。お持ちになった傘は、どのような状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about a purchase. What is the condition of the umbrella you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った折り畳み傘です。開いても止まらず閉じてしまいます。強く押す前に見てもらおうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日購入の折り傘が開いたまま止まらず強く押す前に相談したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a folding umbrella I bought yesterday. When I open it, it does not stay open and closes again. I decided to have it checked before pushing hard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say yesterday's folding umbrella will not stay open and you sought advice before pushing it hard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に動かさず、その状態を担当に伝えましょう。購入したときのレシートはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not force it; let us explain its condition to the person responsible. Do you have the receipt from the purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: レシートと袋を持っています。家で一度開いただけで、部品を外したり直したりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートと袋があり一度開いただけで分解修理していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the receipt and the bag. I only opened it once at home and have not removed parts or tried to repair it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have the receipt and bag, opened it only once, and have not dismantled or repaired it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使用した状況も伺いました。交換や返金の扱いは、担当が商品と購入情報を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for explaining how it was used. The person responsible will explain exchange or refund arrangements after checking the item and purchase information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に交換できると決めず、確認をお願いします。売場で別の傘を選んで持って来る必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交換可否を決めつけず確認を頼み別の傘を先に選ぶ必要を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please check it without assuming an exchange is possible. Do I need to choose another umbrella on the sales floor and bring it here first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a check without assuming an exchange, and ask whether to choose another umbrella first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ別の商品は選ばず、今の傘の確認を待ちましょう。こちらで開くときは担当が周囲を見て行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not choose another item yet; wait for this umbrella to be checked. If it is opened here, the person responsible will first check the surrounding area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分では開かず待ちます。どの部分が止まらないか、閉じたまま指して説明してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分では開かず閉じたまま不具合の箇所を示せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait without opening it myself. May I point out the part that does not stay in place while keeping it closed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may indicate the faulty part while keeping the umbrella closed and not opening it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 閉じた状態で気づいた所を示してください。先ほどのお話と合わせて、担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please point to what you noticed while it is closed. I will pass that along with what you told me earlier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この留める部分が気になりました。昨日の購入と一度の使用、修理していないことを伝え、確認後の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 留める部分を示し購入日と一度使用と未修理を伝え確認後の案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: This fastening part caught my attention. I will explain that I bought it yesterday, used it once and have not repaired it, then wait for instructions after the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Point to the fastening part, give the purchase date, one use and no repairs, then wait for instructions after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、レシートと傘をお預かりして確認します。ご案内までこちらでお待ちください。お呼びするときにまたお話しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the receipt and umbrella to check them. Please wait here for instructions. We will speak again when we call you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出口の案内をご覧ですね。散歩の後はどちらへお帰りになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the exit directions. Where do you plan to return after your walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車を置いた駐車場へ戻りたいです。入った門から出るつもりですが、図に東口と西口があり迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐車場へ戻るため入場門から出るつもりだが二出口があって迷うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to return to the car park where I left my car. I intended to leave by the gate I entered, but the map shows east and west exits and I became unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you planned to leave by the entrance gate to reach the car park but are confused by two exits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の図では、駐車場は西口側です。入ったときに近くに何が見えたか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this practice map, the car park is on the west-exit side. Do you remember what you saw nearby when you entered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 石の看板と売店がありました。車を置いて少し外の道を歩いたので、駐車場側の門から入ったとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 石看板と売店を見たが駐車後に外道を歩き駐車場側から入ったとは限らないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There was a stone sign and a shop. I walked along an outside road for a while after parking, so I did not necessarily enter through the gate on the car-park side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you saw a stone sign and shop, but walked outside after parking and may not have entered on the car-park side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入った門と車の位置は別に確認したいですね。いま休憩してから戻るなら、どの辺りで休みたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We should check the entrance gate and the car's location separately. If you rest before returning, where would you like to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中央の池の横で休みたいです。そこから西口へ出る道を図で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中央池横で休んでから西口へ出る道を図で確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to rest beside the central pond. I want to check the route from there to the west exit on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to rest beside the central pond and check the route from there to the west exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 池から西口へ向かう線をたどってみてください。東口へ近い道と分かれる所に表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Try following the line from the pond toward the west exit. There is a sign where it branches from the route nearer the east exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かれ道の表示で西口を確認します。もし東口へ出てしまったら、車が見えないからと外の道を適当に歩かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分岐で西口表示を読み誤って東口へ出ても外道を適当に進まないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check for the west exit on the sign at the fork. If I accidentally leave through the east exit, I will not walk aimlessly along an outside road just because I cannot see my car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will read the west-exit sign at the fork and will not wander outside even if you mistakenly leave by the east exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わからなくなったら図と表示を見直すか、係へ尋ねてください。休憩場所から戻る方向も出発前に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you become unsure, check the map and signs again or ask a staff member. Check the direction back from the rest area before setting off too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 池で休む前に西口への線を確認し、歩き出したら分かれ道の表示を見ます。車の場所と入った門を混同しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩前に西口線を確認し歩くとき分岐表示を見て入場門と車の位置を混同しないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Before resting by the pond, I will check the line to the west exit, then watch the fork signs when walking. I will avoid confusing my car's location with the gate I entered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the west-exit route before resting, read fork signs while walking and distinguish the entrance gate from the car's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、休憩も含めてゆっくりお過ごしください。それでは、お帰りは西口の案内を確かめながらどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time, including a rest. When returning, follow and check the west-exit directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検索画面の候補について、確認をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the options on the search screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行き先を入れたら、同じ読みの名前が二つ出ました。どちらを選べばいいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検索で同じ読みの候補が二つ出て選べないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I entered my destination, two names with the same pronunciation appeared. I do not know which to select.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say two search options have the same pronunciation and you cannot choose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駅名の表記と、行く地域を確認しましょう。訪問先の住所はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check how the station name is written and the area you are going to. Do you know your destination's address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所のメモはあります。この市の施設へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訪問先の市と住所メモを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a note of the address. I want to go to a facility in this city.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the destination city and your address note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住所と最寄り駅は別の情報です。訪問先の案内に駅名も載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The address and nearest station are separate pieces of information. Does the destination's information also give a station name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内には載っていません。施設へ駅名を確認してから、候補を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 施設案内に駅名がなく施設へ確認してから候補を選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is not in the information. I would like to ask the facility for the station name before selecting an option.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the facility information lacks a station name and you will check with the facility before choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 候補を確定するまでは購入を進めないでください。日付も確認しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not proceed with a purchase until the option is confirmed. Let us check the date as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 行く日は来月の二日です。画面が今日の日付のままなので、そこも変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来月二日の予定なのに画面が今日のままで変更すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am going on the second of next month. The screen still shows today's date, so I will change that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you plan to go on the second of next month but the screen still shows today and you will change it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駅名と日付をそろえてから、購入できる切符を担当者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the station name and date are correct, ask the person responsible which tickets can be purchased.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 施設に駅名を聞き、日付を変更した画面で相談し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅名を聞き予定日に直した画面で切符相談を再開すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the facility for the station name and consult you again with the screen changed to my planned date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will get the station name, correct the planned date and resume the ticket consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 誤った候補のまま購入せず確認するということで承りました。情報がそろいましたら、また窓口へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood: you will check instead of buying with an incorrect option. Please return to the counter once you have the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知について、どなたからのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Who is making the enquiry about the notice you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父宛ての封筒です。父が机に置いていったので、代わりに何かする必要があるのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父宛て封筒を持ち父の代わりに何か必要か知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The envelope is addressed to my father. He left it on the desk, and I want to know whether I need to do anything on his behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought an envelope addressed to your father and want to know whether action on his behalf is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お父様から確認を頼まれたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did your father ask you to check it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ頼まれていません。封筒も開いていないので、内容はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父に頼まれておらず未開封で内容不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: He has not asked me yet. The envelope is unopened, so I do not know what is inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your father has not asked and you do not know the contents because it is unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まずご本人に確認してください。封筒の表面だけで手続きや期限は断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask him first. We cannot determine the procedure or deadline from the outside of the envelope alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勝手に中を見て判断せず、父に通知を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勝手に開いて判断せず父自身に確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not open it and decide without permission; I will ask my father to check the notice himself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not open it and decide on your own, but have your father check it himself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 代理で相談する場合の範囲も、担当窓口で確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible counter must also confirm the scope of consultation by a representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父が相談を頼んだ場合に備えて、窓口の連絡先を調べる方法だけ聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 父の依頼後に備え連絡先を調べる方法だけ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: In case my father asks me to enquire, may I just ask how to find the counter's contact details?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask only how to find the contact details in preparation for a request from your father. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表面に記載された発行元を確認し、担当窓口の案内につなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the issuer written on the outside and direct you to the responsible counter's information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は発行元の確認までにして、父の返事を聞いてから詳しい相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発行元確認までにとどめ父の返答後に詳しく相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: For now I will only confirm the issuer, and discuss the details after hearing back from my father.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will stop at checking the issuer and consult in detail after your father's response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人と相談なさってから、必要に応じて担当窓口へご連絡ください。封筒をお忘れにならないようお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: After discussing it with him, contact the responsible counter if necessary. Please remember to take the envelope home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付の順番を確認したいとのことですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check your turn at reception, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて来ました。似た名前を呼ばれた気がしましたが、私のことか自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初診で似た氏名を呼ばれたが自分か確信がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first visit. I think I heard a name similar to mine, but I am not sure it was me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say this is your first visit and a similar name was called, but you are unsure it was yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 思い込んで進まず、ご自身のお名前を担当者に確認してください。今日はどうなさいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please confirm your own name with the person responsible instead of assuming and proceeding. What brings you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手首が痛くて来ました。誰かを呼ぶ声と受付の説明を聞き違えたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手首痛で来院し呼びかけと受付説明を混同した可能性を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My wrist hurts. I may have confused someone being called with the reception instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you came for wrist pain and may have confused a call with reception instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 症状は医療スタッフへ引き継ぎます。痛みはいつ頃からですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass your symptoms to the medical staff. When did the pain start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: おとといからです。初診の受付場所と、必要な持ち物も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: おとといからと伝え初診窓口と持ち物を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The day before yesterday. I also want to ask where first-visit reception is and what I need to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it began the day before yesterday and ask about first-visit reception and required items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち物の扱いは受付担当者が確認します。今日はどのようなものを持参されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The reception staff will check the requirements for your items. What have you brought today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人確認に使えると思った書類を持っています。ここで見せてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人確認用と思う書類を持参し今提示してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought documents I thought could be used to identify me. May I show them here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought documents you believe can identify you and ask whether you may show them now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず提示先を確認します。周囲から見えないよう、書類は手元でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: First we will confirm whom to show them to. Please keep the documents with you so people nearby cannot see them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と受付場所を確認してから書類を出します。呼び声だけで動かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名と受付位置を確かめてから書類を示し呼び声だけで進まないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm my name and the reception location before taking out the documents. I will not move just because I hear a call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm your name and reception location before showing documents and not proceed based only on a call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 初診の担当受付へご案内します。症状もそこでお伝えください。私はご案内を終えますので、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will guide you to first-visit reception. Please tell them your symptoms there too. My guidance ends here, so I will excuse myself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 名札を拾われたと伺いました。状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you found a name badge. Please tell me what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道に名札が落ちていました。名前と番号があるので、直接連絡しようか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道の名札に名前と番号があり直接連絡すべきか迷ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a name badge on the pavement. It has a name and number, so I wondered whether to contact the person directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a badge on the pavement had a name and number and you wondered whether to contact the person directly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号の意味や持ち主は確認できません。まず拾った状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot confirm what the number means or who owns it. First, please tell me how you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夕方五時ごろ、商店の前で見つけました。店にはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕方五時ごろ商店前で発見し店には未照会と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I found it in front of a shop around five in the evening. I have not asked at the shop yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you found it outside a shop around five in the evening and have not asked the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名札は今どのように保管していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: How are you keeping the badge now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 透明な袋に入れました。人に名前が見えないよう、紙で覆っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 透明袋に入れ名前を紙で隠していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put it in a transparent bag. I covered it with paper so other people cannot see the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is in a transparent bag with the name covered by paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 個人情報を広く見せずに持参されたのですね。こちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You brought it without exposing the personal information to people around you. We will check it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真を友人に送ったりはしていません。袋ごと渡してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真を他人へ送っておらず袋ごと渡せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not sent a photograph to friends or anyone else. May I hand it over in the bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not sent a photo to others and ask whether you may hand it over with the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのままお渡しください。発見した店の位置もわかる範囲で説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hand it over as it is. Describe the shop's location as far as you know too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号には電話せず、名札を渡します。店の位置は、この地図の角を示して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号へ電話せず名札を渡し地図で店の位置を説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand in the badge without calling the number. I will explain the shop's location by pointing to this corner on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will hand in the badge without calling the number and explain the shop's location on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発見場所と保管の状況を確認します。届けていただきありがとうございました。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will confirm where it was found and how you kept it. Thank you for bringing it in. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい住所の記入でご不明な点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you are unsure about when filling in the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地図で調べた住所と契約書の住所が違います。転居の手続きにどちらを書くか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地図と契約書の住所が違い転居申込への記入を迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The address I found on the map differs from the one on the contract. I am unsure which to write for the moving procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the map and contract show different addresses and you are unsure what to put on the moving application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 違っている部分を分けて確認しましょう。建物名や部屋番号でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the differing parts separately. Is it the building name or room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地図には建物の別の名前が出て、部屋番号は載っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図は別建物名で部屋番号がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The map shows a different building name and does not list the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the map has another building name and no room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検索結果だけで正式な送付先を決めず、契約書の内容も管理者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not determine the official mailing address from a search result alone; also confirm the contract details with the manager.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 管理会社に、郵便物が届く表記を聞いてから書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 管理会社に郵便が届く表記を聞いてから書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to ask the management company how to write the address so mail arrives before filling it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the management company for the address wording that mail can reach before writing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できた住所で申込方法を担当者に相談しましょう。旧住所の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us consult the person responsible about applying using the confirmed address. Do you have your old address information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 旧住所は正確に書けます。新しい建物の入口が二つあることも伝えるべきでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所はわかるが新居の二つの入口も伝えるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can write my old address accurately. Should I also mention that the new building has two entrances?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you know the old address and ask whether to mention the new home's two entrances. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配達に関わる情報の伝え方は、担当者へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the person responsible how to communicate information relevant to delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所の表記と入口の情報を確認し、旧住所とそろえて申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表記と入口を確認し正確な旧住所と併せて申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm the address wording and entrance information and apply with those details together with my old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the wording and entrances and apply with the accurate old address as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未確認の表記をそのまま使わず整理なさってください。確認後のご相談をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please sort out the details instead of using unconfirmed wording as it stands. We look forward to helping you after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録情報のどの項目を変更したいとお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which registered details are you thinking of changing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越しと名前の変更がありました。届いた通知は古い名前と住所になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居と氏名変更があり通知に旧氏名と旧住所があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have moved and changed my name. The notice I received has my old name and address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have moved and changed your name but the notice shows the old name and address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 氏名と住所はそれぞれ確認が必要です。変更の方法を担当者に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The name and address each need to be checked. Let us ask the person responsible how to change them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所変更の紙だけで、名前も一緒に変えられると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所用紙で氏名も一緒に変わると思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the address-change form would change my name at the same time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you thought the address form would also change your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な手続きや書類は確認後にご案内します。いまは推測して記入しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain the necessary procedures and documents after checking. Please do not fill anything in based on guesses now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ記入しません。通知の宛名と、今の書類の名前を比べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記入を保留し通知宛名と現在の書類名を見比べてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not fill it in yet. Could you compare the name on the notice with the name on my current documents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait to fill it in and want the notice's addressee compared with the name on your current documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者にお見せください。周囲に情報が見えない方法で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show them to the person responsible. We will check them in a way that keeps the information out of view of others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの変更の順番と、今後の通知先も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 氏名住所の変更順序と今後の通知先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also want to check the order of the two changes and where future notices will be sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the order of the name and address changes and the destination of future notices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その三点を整理して担当者へ伝えます。手続きの完了も説明を受けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will organize those three points and pass them to the person responsible. Please also confirm completion of the procedures after hearing the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所も名前も変更済みと思い込まず、確認結果と残る手続きをメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更済みと決めず結果と残りの手続きを記録すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume either my address or name has already been changed; I will note the findings and any remaining procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume the changes are complete and will record the results and remaining procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知とお持ちの書類をそろえてお待ちください。確認担当を呼んでまいりますので、ここで失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait with the notice and your documents together. I will go and call the person who checks them, so I will excuse myself here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 食品の保存表示で、お探しの情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for particular information on the food storage label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一度に全部は使わないので、開けたあとどう保存するかを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一度に使い切らないため開封後の保存法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will not use it all at once, so I want to know how to store it after opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to store it after opening because you will not use it all at once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 未開封の場合と開封後の案内を分けて見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look separately at the instructions for unopened and opened products.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表の表示は読めましたが、これは開ける前のことなんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表側の保存表示が開封前の条件だと理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I could read the label on the front, but that refers to before opening, does it not?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the front storage label describes conditions before opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 開封後の注意は別の箇所にある場合があります。包装全体を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The precautions after opening may be elsewhere. Please check the entire packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらに見つかりました。使う量が少ないので、小さい商品も比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開封後の欄を見つけ使用量が少ないので小商品も比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found them here. Since I use only a small amount, I also want to compare the smaller product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you found the after-opening section and want to compare a smaller product because you use little. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さい商品でも、原材料や保存の表示が同じかは個別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even with a smaller product, check separately whether its ingredients and storage instructions are the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大きいほうと名前が似ていますが、原材料の順番が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 似た商品名でも原材料の並びが違うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Its name is similar to the larger one's, but the ingredients are in a different order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the ingredient order differs even though the product names are similar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品名が似ているだけで、同じ内容とは判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not assume the contents are the same just because the product names are similar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方の表示を読み、使い切りやすい量と開封後の方法を確認してから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両商品の表示を読み使い切る量と開封後の保存方法で選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read both labels and choose after checking an amount I can finish easily and how to store it after opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will read both labels and choose based on a manageable amount and storage after opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご家庭での使い方に合うものをご検討ください。表示を見直しながら、どうぞお買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consider what suits the way you use it at home. Enjoy your shopping while checking the labels again.
